title: Devī Stuti (Yā Devī)
author: Durgā Saptaśatī, chapter 5
intro: The hymn of the gods to the Goddess from chapter 5 of the Durgā Saptaśatī (Devī Māhātmya). After five verses of salutation comes the famous yā devī sarva-bhūteṣu: twenty-one verses naming the forms in which the Goddess dwells in all beings, each ending namas tasyai namas tasyai namas tasyai namo namaḥ.
note: All verses are in Anuṣṭubh. In the yā devī verses only one word changes each time, so learning the pattern once opens the whole hymn. Verses follow the commonly printed text; printed editions include a few more verses in this section.
